newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Southeast spot power firms amid storm watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Southeast spot power firms amid storm watch.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the southeastern U.S. firmed Wednesday as participants in the Southeastern Electric Reliability Council (SERC) tracked the movement of Tropical Storm Lili, market sources said.
"We're keeping an eye on it," said a Florida utility trader, adding the possibility of Lili hitting the penisula was still remote.
Thick clouds and possible rain linked to Lili in the southern portion of Florida were expected to depress power demand through the end of the week, market sources said.
The tropical storm stalled temporarily south-southwest of Cuba today, but was predicted to resume a northward drift.
Next-day prices of power into Florida was quoted higher than Tuesday's levels amid transmission limits and return of a couple of nuclear power plants.
Georgia Power Co resumed operation at its 1,162 megawatt (MW) Vogtle 2 nuclear power unit in Waynesboro, Ga., following repairs to a malfunctioning feedwater regulator valve.

Tennessee Valley Authority's (TVA) 1,148 MW Sequoyah Unit 1 nuclear power plant in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., returned to full output late Tuesday after being shut Sunday when a voltage measuring device in its switchyard exploded, spreaded and ignited oil in the device.
At the Georgia/Florida border, next-day firm, peak electricity was assessed at $23.00-$24.00 a megawatt hour, firmer than Tuesday's range of $22.50-$23.50 for Wednesday delivery.
Next-day, firm electricity during light load hours at the Ga./Fla. border was pegged at $13.00-$14.00.
Daily demand for prescheduled power by Florida utilities was thin. "They're buying their needs on a week long basis," said a SERC trader.
Next-day electricity for firm, peak delivery into the northern part of TVA was quoted at $16.00-$17.00, up from a quote of $14.00-$15.00 on Tuesday.
TVA reportedly edged up its offering of peak, non-firm power for next-day delivery to the $19.50-$20.00 area, up from Tuesday's $19.00-$19.50.
